tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer must be registered as per the following Acts in relation to the provision of human resource outsourcing services and copies should be submitted in KPPP portal 1)Labour Act 2) Employees Provident Fund Act 3) Employees State Insurance Act 4) Income Tax Act 5) Goods and Services Tax Act
A satisfactory certificate of 3 years of experience of providing services of at least 50 staff to any Government/Semi-Government offices should be attached.
The tenderer should have an annual turnover of at least Rs. 100 lakhs per year. And 3 years of Average Annual Turnover should be Rs. 100.00 lakhs
all technical bid documents to be submitted as per tender documents
